title: State
description: Per-agent enforcer state, persisted across hook invocations and updated transactionally on each decide() call. Defined in CONTRACTS.md §3.2.

schema_version.description: Protocol schema version. MUST be '1.0' for this revision.

agent_id.description: Unique identifier of the agent this state record belongs to.

tool_calls_since_drain.description: Count of tool calls that have completed since the most recent channels__recv call. Reset to 0 on each recv.

last_drain_ts.description: Unix epoch seconds of the most recent channels__recv call. Null if the agent has never drained.

last_send_ts.description: Unix epoch seconds of the most recent channels__send call. Null if the agent has never sent.

sends_since_last_drain.description: Count of channels__send calls since the most recent channels__recv. Reset to 0 on each recv.

turns_since_last_drain.description: Count of LLM turns (turn_started events) since the most recent channels__recv. Reset to 0 on each recv.
